notes_for_editor: Only one tower-specific source (the 1960 NGS station description) plus the standing listing. No build date, builder, staffing or fire history found. The access level 'restricted' is our reading of the reservation location, not a stated policy; a human should confirm with the reservation before publishing. The NGS description does not say who decides access, so the story now presents that as our reading rather than a sourced fact. The NGS gives an overall height of 110 feet; it is not entered as height_m because the height to the cab floor is unknown. The record's agency matches the Forest Lookouts header.
